theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+0.60%) and Consumer Staples (-0.24%) led the market today, while Materials (-1.78%) and Technology (-1.45%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.43%, defensives -0.66%, and value/cyclicals -0.97% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.58%, Dow -0.60%, Nasdaq -0.65% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.04%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 8.38% to 17.84, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 2.11% to $4,358.00, crude oil was little changed at $103.87, and bitcoin slipped 1.80% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
